chapter_seo_title: Chapter 208 - Something Watched: Li Huowang Faces Unseen Eyes
chapter_meta_description: Something stared at Li Huowang from inside a pickle jar. He didn’t wait to find out what. Chapter 208 delivers a masterclass in dread, survival, and the art of trusting your gut.
og_title: Something Watched: The Stare That Changed Everything
og_description: Li Huowang feels eyes on him from a row of jars. He leaves. He doesn’t sleep. And when the lids open, he’s already there, waiting.
twitter_description: Paranoia saves lives in the Dao-Twisted World. Li Huowang’s gut tells him to run—and he does. But the things that followed? They’re not just ghosts.
